def: properly, to roll flat, i.e. prepare (a road); also to revolve, i.e. weigh (mentally)

occurrences.text: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.
Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.
For the ways of man are before the eyes of the Lord, and he pondereth all his goings.
The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
